summary: Old custom inventory scripts are still in the database after the API removal; export them with awx-manage export_custom_scripts --filename=my_scripts.tar and extract, with names like _<pk>__<name>.
questions: How do I recover old custom inventory scripts?
Where did my custom inventory scripts go after upgrade?

answer_card.title: Export old custom inventory scripts
answer_card.answer_md:
```
awx-manage export_custom_scripts --filename=my_scripts.tar
mkdir my_scripts && tar -xf my_scripts.tar -C my_scripts
```

Each script is named `_<pk>__<name>`. Commit them to source control and use them through a *Sourced from a Project* inventory source.
